verdict.rationale: Omnara's own docs, including a dedicated MCP tools page, say you can add MCP servers such as Linear, Notion, or an internal service to an agent config. Omnara then discovers their tools, so agents can use them directly. missing for 10: details on supported transports and authentication for MCP servers, independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Add a server such as Linear, Notion, or your own internal service to an agent config, and Omnara discovers its tools
Connect MCP servers to give them access to your services and data
